# Python script to extract different segments of the dS tree. This will be useful for calibrating the fusion estimation based on the different segments of the tree. 

```{python, eval=FALSE}
from pathlib import Path
from ete3 import Tree
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


# =============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================

BASE_DIR = Path(".")

# Outgroups used to identify the ingroup
ALL_OUTGROUPS = ["Fal_per", "Ans_ans", "Str_cam"]

# Taxon used to root each gene tree
ROOTING_PRIORITY = ["Str_cam"]

# The two internal calibration/checkpoint taxa
OLDER_OUTGROUP = "Ans_ans"
YOUNGER_OUTGROUP = "Fal_per"

# Names used for the output columns
SEGMENT_1_NAME = "Stem_dS_anser_falcon"
SEGMENT_2_NAME = "Stem_dS_falcon_crown"

# Optional descriptive names for printing/comments
SEGMENT_1_DESCRIPTION = "Anser-split -> Falcon-split"
SEGMENT_2_DESCRIPTION = "Falcon-split -> crown"

# Input files
INPUT_FILES = [
    "auto_genes_values_with_lsv.tsv"
]

# Output suffix
OUTPUT_SUFFIX = "_with_segments.tsv"


# =============================================================================
# TREE UTILITIES
# =============================================================================

def reroot_tree(tree, priority_list):
    leaf_names = set(tree.get_leaf_names())

    for taxon in priority_list:
        if taxon in leaf_names:
            tree.set_outgroup(tree.search_nodes(name=taxon)[0])
            return taxon

    return None


def path_distance(descendant_node, ancestor_node):
    dist = 0.0
    node = descendant_node

    while node != ancestor_node:
        dist += node.dist
        node = node.up

        if node is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "ancestor_node not found in ancestry of descendant_node"
            )

    return dist


def is_ancestor_of(candidate_ancestor, node):
    """Return True if candidate_ancestor lies on the path from node to root."""
    n = node

    while n is not None:
        if n == candidate_ancestor:
            return True
        n = n.up

    return False


# =============================================================================
# SEGMENT EXTRACTION
# =============================================================================

def extract_two_segment_stem(
    tree,
    ingroup_tips,
    older_outgroup,
    younger_outgroup
):
    """
    Split the stem between the older outgroup split and the ingroup crown
    using the younger outgroup split as an internal checkpoint.

    For example:

        older split -------- younger split -------- crown
             |                     |                  |
             |<---- segment 1 ---->|<-- segment 2 -->|

    Returns:
        (segment_1, segment_2, ok)

    where ok=False means that the gene tree does not support the expected
    nesting of the three nodes.
    """

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Ingroup crown
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    crown_node = (
        tree.get_common_ancestor(ingroup_tips)
        if len(ingroup_tips) > 1
        else tree.search_nodes(name=ingroup_tips[0])[0]
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Older and younger calibration/checkpoint nodes
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    node_older = tree.get_common_ancestor(
        [older_outgroup] + ingroup_tips
    )

    node_younger = tree.get_common_ancestor(
        [younger_outgroup] + ingroup_tips
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Check whether both nodes are distinct
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if node_older == node_younger:
        return 0.0, path_distance(crown_node, node_younger), False

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Check expected nesting:
    #
    # older split -> younger split -> crown
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    if not is_ancestor_of(node_older, node_younger):
        return None, None, False

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Calculate the two path segments
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    segment_1 = path_distance(
        node_younger,
        node_older
    )

    segment_2 = path_distance(
        crown_node,
        node_younger
    )

    return segment_1, segment_2, True


# =============================================================================
# PROCESS ONE GENE FILE
# =============================================================================

def process_gene_file(values_file, gene_col="Gene"):

    df = pd.read_csv(values_file, sep="\t")

    segment_1_list = []
    segment_2_list = []
    ok_list = []

    for gene in df[gene_col]:

        tree_file = BASE_DIR / gene / f"{gene}_dS_tree.nwk"

        if not tree_file.exists():
            segment_1_list.append(np.nan)
            segment_2_list.append(np.nan)
            ok_list.append(False)
            continue

        tree = Tree(str(tree_file))

        # Root tree
        reroot_tree(tree, ROOTING_PRIORITY)

        all_tips = tree.get_leaf_names()

        # Identify which outgroups are present
        outgroups_present = [
            t for t in ALL_OUTGROUPS
            if t in all_tips
        ]

        # Everything else is considered ingroup
        ingroup_tips = [
            t for t in all_tips
            if t not in outgroups_present
        ]

        try:
            segment_1, segment_2, ok = extract_two_segment_stem(
                tree=tree,
                ingroup_tips=ingroup_tips,
                older_outgroup=OLDER_OUTGROUP,
                younger_outgroup=YOUNGER_OUTGROUP
            )

        except Exception:
            segment_1, segment_2, ok = None, None, False

        segment_1_list.append(segment_1)
        segment_2_list.append(segment_2)
        ok_list.append(ok)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Add output columns
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    df[SEGMENT_1_NAME] = segment_1_list
    df[SEGMENT_2_NAME] = segment_2_list
    df["segments_resolved"] = ok_list

    n_ok = sum(ok_list)

    print(
        f"{values_file}: "
        f"{n_ok}/{len(df)} genes had a resolvable two-segment split"
    )

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    out_file = values_file.replace(
        ".tsv",
        OUTPUT_SUFFIX
    )

    df.to_csv(
        out_file,
        sep="\t",
        index=False
    )

    print(f">>> Saved {out_file}")

    return df


# =============================================================================
# MAIN
# =============================================================================

if __name__ == "__main__":

    for f in INPUT_FILES:
        process_gene_file(f)

```
